reservedTraits.name: Pack call
reservedTraits.description: Call for any wolves nearby, within a range of miles equal to your CON.

reservedTraits.name: True mate
reservedTraits.description: On birth, all wolves are given a mate by the Lunar World Elves. Upon finding them, they cannot part. Their pheromones act as an aphrodisiac. Gain the Obsessed title.

reservedTraits.name: Pheromone
reservedTraits.description: Secrete pheromones in a circle centered on you with a diameter in feet equal to your Defense. On a roll of your Attack vs their Resist, wolves must submit to you.

reservedTraits.name: Pheromone control
reservedTraits.description: Secrete pheromones in a circle centered on you with a diameter in feet equal to your Defense. On a contested Resist roll, wolves must obey your orders, even if it is to die.

reservedTraits.name: Heat cycle
reservedTraits.description: Choose a day in the month. For the two days leading up to it and after it, double your Attack. On the chosen day, you are incapacitated with the need to mate.

reservedTraits.name: Heat cycle (alpha)
reservedTraits.description: Choose three days in a row in a month. For three days leading up to it and after it, double your Attack. On those days, you are incapacitated with the need to mate. If you mate with anyone other than your true mate, they take damage equal to your Attack every time you engage in intercourse.

reservedTraits.name: Bond
reservedTraits.description: Choose a humanoid to bond with and serve as your master. When that master is within ten feet of you, you may take all damage on their behalf. When they are injured, you may use a free reaction to attack the offender.

reservedTraits.name: Painful bite
reservedTraits.description: Any drain action may be taken simultaneously. The vampire may not regain HP through rest, and must bite to heal. The bite is painful and requires an Attack vs Defense or Resist check to succeed.

reservedTraits.name: Lustful bite
reservedTraits.description: Any drain action may be taken simultaneously. The vampire may not regain HP through rest, and must bite to heal. The bite is pleasurable and targets must succeed a Charm Resistance roll to fight back.

reservedTraits.name: Life steal
reservedTraits.description: When ingesting sexual fluids, steal the mana of the target to replenish your own. Additionally, steal a maximum number of stat points equal to your Power. The target temporarily loses those stat points, and you gain them for a day.

reservedTraits.name: Mute
reservedTraits.description: This creature cannot talk.

reservedTraits.name: Coveted body
reservedTraits.description: Eating the body of this creature will enhance the consumer, adding all stat points to their pools.

reservedTraits.name: Group sticky
reservedTraits.description: When 3 blobstickers successfully attack the same target, that target is immobilized and unable to act until the number is reduced to 2 or less.

reservedTraits.name: Delicacy
reservedTraits.description: Vampires who consume your flesh regain double what they normally would. In addition, they gain your highest stat as a bonus of stat/5 for an entire day. They must succeed a Frenzy Resistance to not continue consuming your blood until you die.

reservedTraits.name: Blood frenzy
reservedTraits.description: When this creature scents blood, it gains double Attack.

reservedTraits.name: Sleepless
reservedTraits.description: This creature is Immune to Insomnia.

reservedSkills.name: Poison arrow

reservedSkills.name: Sleep arrow
reservedSkills.description: Instead of dealing damage, the target falls asleep until woken up.

reservedSkills.name: Gravity
reservedSkills.description: Costs 10 Mana. Manipulate gravity, causing any of the following effects on a success.

reservedSkills.name: Terraform (World Elf)
reservedSkills.description: Manipulate a square mileage of earth equal to your Power stat. Costs 2 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Climate control
reservedSkills.description: Manipulate the climate of an area in miles equal to your Power. Costs 30 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Annihilation
reservedSkills.description: Summon a massive, superhot ball of flames that deals damage equal to your MAG in a diameter in feet equal to your Power.

reservedSkills.name: River God
reservedSkills.description: When near your body of water, manipulate it at will. Anything pulled into it will drown in 10 turns. To fight against this spell, they must succeed a Defense vs your Power.

reservedSkills.name: Trick
reservedSkills.description: Create a small sensory trick such as an illusion or temporarily changing an appearance.

reservedSkills.name: Treat
reservedSkills.description: Create a small reward, like a boost of 10% on your next task or a yummy snack.

reservedSkills.name: Parasite
reservedSkills.description: Plant a parasite within another on a successful attack. Anyone with a parasite within them must obey commands, from any distance, with a Power vs Resist roll. The parasite dies when the creature that implanted it or host dies. Costs 5 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Shadow Jump
reservedSkills.description: When in a shadow (already used Obscure), jump to another one, unseen. Costs 1 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Sweet smell
reservedSkills.description: Lure a target with a sweet scent with a Power vs Resist check. Costs 1 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Kindness
reservedSkills.description: Encourage another by presence to be kinder with a Power vs Resist or Charm Resistance check. Costs 3 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Soothe
reservedSkills.description: Make another's mind calm and feel better. Costs 3 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Aphordisiac
reservedSkills.description: Emit a scent that elicits desire with a Power vs Resist or Charm Resistance check. Costs 2 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Emotion
reservedSkills.description: Implant a false emotion with a Power vs Resist or Charm Resistance check. Costs 3 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Healing slime
reservedSkills.description: Take a section of your body to make a healing potion that heals a number of HP that you take from yourself.

reservedSkills.name: Poison slime
reservedSkills.description: Regardless of Defense, deal 1 poison damage for a number of turns equal to your Power on a successful attack.

reservedSkills.name: Enchanting voice
reservedSkills.description: Using words (not song), lure a target where you want. CHA/5 vs Resist or Charm Resistance. Costs 2 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Water lure
reservedSkills.description: Bend water to grapple a target with Power vs Defense. Costs 2 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Siren song (Dark Siren)
reservedSkills.description: Seduce and lure a target with a song from a distance equal to Power miles. CHA/5 vs Resist or Charm Resistance. Costs 5 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Siren song
reservedSkills.description: Seduce and lure a target with a song from a distance equal to Power feet. CHA/5 vs Resist or Charm Resistance. Costs 5 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Poison beak
reservedSkills.description: Attack normally. On a hit, the target takes Power damage for a number of turns equal to your Power. Costs 1 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Grapple suction
reservedSkills.description: Attack normally. On a hit, the target must succeed an Attack vs Defense or be grappled until they do.

reservedSkills.name: Commanding Voice
reservedSkills.description: Any creature of your species that hears you speak will want to obey with a Power vs Resist.

reservedSkills.name: Manipulate animal
reservedSkills.description: Any animal with an INT lower than your Power will obey your any command. Costs 5 Mana per command.

reservedSkills.name: Manipulate state
reservedSkills.description: Change the physical state of any water in a radius of your Power. Freezing or boiling water deals Power damage. Costs 5 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Manipulate weather
reservedSkills.description: Manipulate the weather of a square mileage equal to your Power. Costs 12 Mana.

reservedSkills.name: Guardian crow
reservedSkills.description: Choose a charge to protect and nurture. The charge must not be an adult, and must be entirely alone. You will always know where your charge is.

Light.description: Seal a creature in glowing chains of light. Costs 10 Mana. Contested Power vs target Resist per turn to maintain.

Light.name: Purify
Light.description: Deal light damage = to your Power. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 2 Mana.

Light.name: Halo
Light.description: Shroud yourself in light magic, healing 4 HP in a radius of 5 ft every turn for 10 turns. Costs 5 Mana.

Light.name: Cure
Light.description: Cure a sickness or disease. Costs 5 Mana.

Light.name: Shroud of light

Light.description: Give someone +10% on their next task. Costs 1 Mana.

Darkness.name: Destroy
Darkness.description: Deal damage = to your Power. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 1 Mana.

Darkness.name: Darkness
Darkness.description: Create darkness in a radius of 30 ft. Costs 1 Mana.

Darkness.name: Curse
Darkness.description: Curse a creature. For every turn your Power wins against their Resist, they will be confused, unable to act except to take random actions. Random action d4: 1- attack self, 2- wander aimlessly, 3- do nothing, 4- attack random nearby target.

Darkness.name: Shadow stalker
Darkness.description: Enter someone's shadow. You are hidden until you leave. Costs 10 Mana.

Darkness.name: Vacuum
Darkness.description: Obliterate the air in a radius = to your Power. Costs 2 Mana.

Darkness.name: Hide
Darkness.description: Obfuscate your presence. Lasts until you move. Costs 2 Mana.

Darkness.name: Shroud of darkness
Darkness.description: Create a shroud of darkness in a style of your preference for 10 minutes. It may take one of the following qualities. Costs 10 Mana.

Darkness.name: Corrupt
Darkness.description: Cause a weapon on touch to corrupt, doubling its damage modifier. On a miss, it damages the user by 1. Costs 2 Mana.

Fire.name: Create flame
Fire.description: Light a small flame, like a lighter would. No Mana cost.

Fire.name: Fireball
Fire.description: Cast a fireball that goes 30 ft forward and hits all targets within its path for damage = to your Power. Costs 5 Mana.

Fire.name: Manipulate flames
Fire.description: Manipulate flames in a radius of ft = to your Magic stat.

Fire.name: Flame arc
Fire.description: Create flames in a burst originating from your body and going out in all directions for 30 ft, dealing damage = to your Power to all targets.

Fire.name: Blue flame
Fire.description: For its next attack, a weapon of your choice becomes hot, dealing additional damage = to your Power. Costs 3 Mana.

Fire.name: Summon sprite
Fire.description: Summon a sprite with a 5 in all stats that acts on your command. It disappears on death. Costs 10 Mana.

Fire.name: Meteor
Fire.description: Summon a massive ball of fire to the earth, dealing damage = to your Power in a circle with a diameter = to your Power. Costs 15 Mana.

Fire.name: Wall of fire
Fire.description: Encircle a target in flames, dealing damage = to your Power whenever a target tries to pass.

Fire.name: Smith
Fire.description: Modify a weapon to increase its damage by 1. Can only be done to a single weapon once. On failure, the weapon disintegrates. On a critical, its damage increases by 2. Costs 20 Mana.

Fire.name: Flame shroud
Fire.description: Engulf yourself in flames for one minute, dealing damage = to your Power to all you touch. Costs 10 Mana.

Water.name: Create water
Water.description: Create a small amount of water, enough to fit into a cup. No Mana cost.

Water.name: Rain of Icicles
Water.description: Create a # of icicles = to your Power. Each deals damage = to 1/2 your Power, rounded down. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 4 Mana.

Water.name: Fog
Water.description: Create a thick fog in a 100 ft radius. All creatures within have to succeed on a Perception task to take their actions. Costs 2 Mana.

Water.name: Manipulate water
Water.description: Manipulate water in a radius of ft = to your Magic stat.

Water.name: Water bindings
Water.description: Grapple a target. They may initiate a Power vs Strength check every turn to get out. Costs 2 Mana.

Water.name: Sublimate
Water.description: Boil the blood within a living target on touch, dealing damage = to Power, ignoring Resistances. Costs 10 Mana.

Water.name: Summon sprite
Water.description: Summon a sprite with a 5 in all stats that acts on your command. It disappears on death. Costs 10 Mana.

Water.name: Water bullet
Water.description: Shoot a number of armor-penetrating bullets = to your Power. Each deals 1 damage, but can be resisted by Damage and Frost resistance. Costs 8 Mana.

Water.name: Walk on water
Water.description: Walk on water for an hour. Costs 2 Mana.

Water.name: Breathe underwater
Water.description: Breathe underwater for 1 hour. Costs 1 Mana.

Water.name: Quick Swimming
Water.description: Double movement speed underwater for an hour. Costs 2 Mana.

Earth.name: Terraform
Earth.description: Manipulate a square footage of earth = to your Power stat. Costs 2 Mana. Rocks have HP = to how much square footage they are before crumbling.

Earth.name: Earth armor
Earth.description: By touch, grant someone additional damage resistance = to your Power. Lasts for 10 minutes. Costs 3 Mana.

Earth.name: Sharpen edge
Earth.description: Sharpen metal to a razor edge, granting it additional damage = to your Power for a # of uses = to 1/2 your Power rounded down. Costs 4 Mana.

Earth.name: Catapult
Earth.description: Fling rock in the air, dealing damage = to your Power. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 2 Mana.

Earth.name: Influence creature
Earth.description: Influence a creature whose Intelligence is lower than your Magic. They can obey minor commands, such as attack, sit, and carry, but will not harm themself and will still prioritize their own instincts. Costs 3 Mana.

Earth.name: Venom strike
Earth.description: Adds poison to a weapon attack. This poison reduces the opponent's Physical Damage Resistance by your Power, minus their Poison Resistance, for 1 minute. Costs 2 Mana.

Earth.name: Summon sprite
Earth.description: Summon a sprite with a 5 in all stats that acts on your command. It disappears on death. Costs 10 Mana.

Earth.name: Grow
Earth.description: Make a plant grow. Costs 1 Mana.

Earth.name: Decay
Earth.description: On touch, organic matter decays, taking damage = to your Power. This damage cannot be healed by anything but white magic.

Earth.name: Vitality
Earth.description: Enhance a living being, granting it a bonus to its stats = to your Power for 1 minute. Costs 5 Mana.

Earth.name: Tunnel
Earth.description: Tunnel beneath the earth. Your next attack has a +10 to accuracy. Costs 3 Mana.

Wind.name: Air pocket
Wind.description: Create a pocket of air in a radius = to your Power. Lasts 10 minutes. Costs 3 Mana.

Wind.name: Wind Blade
Wind.description: Slash with a blade of wind, dealing damage = to your Power. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 2 Mana.

Wind.name: Tornado
Wind.description: Create a swirling vortex, pulling all those in a radius = to your Magic who fail a Constitution roll inside for as many turns as they fail a Power vs Strength check. Costs 5 Mana.

Wind.name: Levitation
Wind.description: Float a # of feet = to your Power off the ground. Lasts 10 minutes. Costs 2 Mana.

Wind.name: Speed Boost
Wind.description: Double movement speed for those in a 5 ft radius next to you for 10 minutes. Costs 2 Mana.

Wind.name: Move
Wind.description: Move a small object a # of feet = to your Power. Costs 1 Mana.

Wind.name: Summon sprite
Wind.description: Summon a sprite with a 5 in all stats that acts on your command. It disappears on death. Costs 10 Mana.

Wind.name: Fly
Wind.description: For 1 minute, you can fly. Costs 5 Mana.

Wind.name: Push
Wind.description: Knock over a target on a Power vs Defense roll. While prone, all attacks against them succeed. Costs 3 Mana.

Wind.name: Sound
Wind.description: Make a short sound a maximum number of feet equal to your MAG away. Costs 1 Mana.

Electricity.name: Lightning
Electricity.description: Call forth a great bolt, causing damage = to your Power to everyone in a 20 ft radius (or more if in water). Must be outdoors. Double damage for targets wearing metal. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 3 Mana.

Electricity.name: Spark
Electricity.description: Cast a small arc of electricity towards someone, shocking them for as many turns as they fail a Power vs. Constitution roll.

Electricity.name: Surge
Electricity.description: On touch, cause damage = to Power. Costs 1 Mana.

Electricity.name: Supercharge
Electricity.description: Charge reflexes on touch, granting a bonus = to Power to all Agility tasks for 10 minutes. Costs 3 Mana.

Electricity.name: Manipulate electronic
Electricity.description: Force an electronic to turn off, surge, or explode. Damage of explosion is always 4. Costs 2 Mana.

Electricity.name: Summon sprite
Electricity.description: Summon a sprite with a 5 in all stats that acts on your command. It disappears on death. Costs 10 Mana.

Electricity.name: Plasma
Electricity.description: Supercharge particles, dealing damage = to your Power x 2 on touch. Costs 10 Mana.

Electricity.name: Convert
Electricity.description: Recharge Mana with electricity, causing a temporary blackout. Charges 4 Mana.

Electricity.name: Electric arc
Electricity.description: Attack multiple targets, splitting the damage caused by your Power among them. Costs 2 Mana.

Electricity.name: Ground
Electricity.description: Take all of the electricity out of an area of feet = to your MAG. Costs 5 Mana.

Blood.name: Blood flame
Blood.description: Light one's blood on fire, dealing Power damage to those who touch it. Costs 2 Mana.

Blood.name: Revenge
Blood.description: Upon taking damage, your next attack adds half the damage you received onto its normal damage. Does not guarantee a hit. Costs 2 Mana.

Blood.name: Mana drain
Blood.description: Ingest blood to regain Mana, draining the opponent's Mana. 2 Mana per turn.

Blood.name: HP drain
Blood.description: Ingest blood to regain HP, draining the opponent's HP. 2 HP per turn, ignoring resistance.

Blood.name: Cursebreaker
Blood.description: End all status effects and prevent new ones for a number of turns = to Power. Costs 3 Mana.

Blood.name: Polymorph
Blood.description: Change parts of your body. Costs 2 Mana.

Blood.name: Empower
Blood.description: Add 1/5 of one of your stats to a target's stat for 1 hour. Costs 5 Mana.

Blood.name: Madness
Blood.description: On a success, cause the target to go into a Frenzy. Costs 2 Mana.

Blood.name: Obscure
Blood.description: Hide within a shadow, unseen until you move. When you attack after being hidden, your crit chance is +20. Costs 3 Mana.

Blood.name: Enchant
Blood.description: Make your eyes glow. Anyone who sees it must succeed a Power vs Resist roll or be enchanted, obeying commands until they are harmed. Costs 5 Mana.

Blood.name: Influence
Blood.description: Plant a suggestion in someone's mind, making them subconsciously lean towards it. They will not act on anything outside of their moral compass. Power vs Resist. Costs 5 Mana.

Martial.name: Flame Fury Fist
Martial.description: Punch with so much power flames begin to swirl about. Deal damage = to Attack and Power. Costs 2 Mana.

Martial.name: Feather-Light Steps
Martial.description: Increase Agility tasks by Power for 1 hour. Costs 2 Mana.

Martial.name: Art of One-Thousand Blossoms
Martial.description: Dance with your sword, attacking three times in one turn. Costs 2 Mana.

Martial.name: Ice Spear Avalanche
Martial.description: Imbue your spear with frost, freezing the opponent on a hit. They may try to get out with a contested Power vs Strength check. When they do, the shards deal Power damage to all adjacent parties.

Martial.name: Wrath of the Storm
Martial.description: Fall into a primordial rage, doubling your Attack. You are unable to differentiate between friend and foe. Lasts 1 minute. Costs 1 Mana.

Martial.name: Claws of the Beast
Martial.description: Long, sharp claws protrude from your fingers for 10 minutes. Each deals 4 additional damage.

Martial.name: Immovable Earth
Martial.description: For 10 minutes, you cannot be affected by any status effects.

Martial.name: Perfect Harmony
Martial.description: When within 10 feet of any number of trusted comrades, gain a bonus = Power x number of comrades within range to all tasks. Costs 2 Mana.

Martial.name: Drunken Hand
Martial.description: When inebriated, gain Power damage to all hand-to-hand attacks. Costs 1 Mana for every hit this bonus is used; it does not cost Mana on a miss.

Martial.name: Sea King's Trident
Martial.description: Summon a wave of water with your staff or spear, pushing opponents back in a contested (Power + Constitution) vs Constitution roll a number of feet = to Power. Costs 2 Mana.

Martial.name: Sniper King
Martial.description: All ranged attacks, for the next minute, have a +20% chance to hit. Costs 2 Mana.

Omniscient.name: Prophecy
Omniscient.description: Give a prophecy of a specific topic. Costs 10 Mana.

Omniscient.name: See through space
Omniscient.description: See a number of miles = to Magic away for 1 hour. Costs 10 Mana.

Omniscient.name: Step through space
Omniscient.description: Teleport a number of miles = to Magic away. Costs 10 Mana.

Omniscient.name: Domain
Omniscient.description: Create a domain. When taking actions within it, gain +10%. Costs 10 Mana to create and 1 Mana per day to maintain. Cannot overlap with another Omniscient domain.

Omniscient.name: Create matter
Omniscient.description: Create an object a number of inches long = to the amount of Mana spent.

Ascendant.name: Calamity
Ascendant.description: When you roll a critical fail, something happens.

Ascendant.name: Miracle
Ascendant.description: When you roll a critical success, something happens.
